text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, I accompany Nishino Flower in waiting for one of her flowers to bloom. Apparently, it only blooms at night.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm… It should bloom any moment now…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yawn…
choice_data_list: You all right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I usually go to bed at this time, so I'm a bit sleepy…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm going to do my best to stay up tonight! I want to be here when this flower blooms!
choice_data_list: Then let's stay and wait a little longer.
You shouldn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, but please don't push yourself, okay? I was the one who made you come out here with me, after all…
choice_data_list: Right back at you. Don't push yourself either, got it?
Right back at you. Don't push yourself either, got it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower and I continue to chat while waiting for the flower to bloom…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?! I-I wasn't asleep, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There's no telling when the flower will bloom, so I have to stay alert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower fights valiantly against her drowsiness, but as time passes, the flower bud remains stubbornly shut…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, the flower is still tightly closed when the sun rises…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zzz… Zzz…
choice_data_list: Flower. Wake up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-it's morning already?! Sorry, I didn't mean to fall asleep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Did the flower—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: I'm sorry. It didn't.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, it's okay. I knew these flowers don't bloom very often. Besides…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I had a great time waiting here with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If, um… we ever have the chance, will you watch the flower with me again?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though the flower didn't bloom, my bond with Nishino Flower feels a little stronger than before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Here's to another night of flower watching!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I didn't want you to catch a chill, so I brought some hot tea with me. Here you go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower and I drink tea and chat while waiting for the flower to bloom…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, the flower is still tightly closed when the sun rises…
choice_data_list: It's too bad it didn't bloom this time either…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm sure it'll bloom next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So—
choice_data_list: Let's try waiting for it again another night, okay?
Let's try waiting for it again another night, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though the flower didn't bloom, my bond with Nishino Flower feels a little stronger than before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm not overdoing it! Just look at how full of energy I—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yawn…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh…
choice_data_list: Do you want to take a nap?
Do you want to take a nap?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: B-but…
choice_data_list: Staying up the entire night won't do you any favors.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …You're right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll take a short nap.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, but make sure you don't overdo it either, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I won't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to take turns napping and coming back out to check on the flower…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Nishino Flower and I both sleep straight through to the next morning. When we wake up, we both rush to the flower in a panic to see…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haha… Of course it bloomed last night.
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh no, it's okay! You don't need to apologize! I mean, I fell asleep too, so…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. It's funny, though, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't believe we both slept straight through it blooming.
choice_data_list: I guess that makes us real birds of a feather, huh?
I guess that makes us real birds of a feather, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I guess it does. ♪
